caseLimitations.C-02: A-F do not cover callbacks after Yield drains the queue or pending intent when Enable exits before the claimant. 337 scans show no observed overlap; derived 0 ms is not a continuous measurement. Lifetime exclusive flock and native second-writer refusal substantiate exclusion. E explicitly kills probes after ten seconds, not a native idle-exit test.
caseLimitations.H-10: Close-case supplementary selection inventories are empty; rely on target-only fixed script, retained native focus evidence and conservative results, not the vacuous unchanged-selection assertion. Space route is 1109 ms; 96 ms is its subsequent visibility witness.
caseLimitations.H-11: The genuine adapter result is withheld after the native request settles; real renderer initialization remains pending. No claim of GPU driver work remaining busy during the entire hold.
caseLimitations.qualificationIsolation: Native route fault variants/handlers and resource holds compile out. Release rejects qualification clients; the known resource-hold UI envelope parses but returns NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Frontend helpers remain bundled but inactive behind the immutable native flag; no supported release fault-execution path. M15 production-artifact cleanup remains required.

remainingCodeDefects.minimumRemediation: Preserve accepted pending intents across both handoff exits until responsibility transfers; deterministic post-drain/delayed-hydration, delayed/unavailable claimant and handoff-reply-failure coverage, then targeted native notification/handoff regression.

remainingCodeDefects.finding: Only pre-focus time is checked; fresh phase budgets permit late exact/OK after the hard two-second native route deadline.
remainingCodeDefects.minimumRemediation: One remaining deadline across native validation/focus/readback/postvalidation, conservative expiration with honest already-issued OS-effect evidence, deterministic delayed-phase coverage and ordinary/fullscreen native regression.

c02.protocol: Accepted intents persisted to the store before delivery and removed on consumption; any writer loads them on taking the lock. Late, overflow and forwarded responses spooled per notification request and recovered as inspector intents. Every voluntary writer exit is Release on the writer thread (close acceptance, finish accepted commands, wait for spooling, exit). Yield reply reports only; claimant waits for the lock regardless. Enable refusal stays until the claim.

consumptionRetryRemediation.reviewFinding: C-02B repeated IntentConsumed(X) answered Done while X's durable removal was uncommitted
consumptionRetryRemediation.rootCause: The writer recorded only a flag that some consumed intent's removal was unrecorded; a repeated IntentConsumed found the intent absent from memory and answered Done unconditionally.
consumptionRetryRemediation.repair: The writer keeps the IDs of consumed intents the committed backlog still lists; a repeat for one of them retries the backlog commit from the current state and is Done only if it commits, otherwise Unavailable; any successful commit records them all; a repeat after that, or for an ID never held, is Done without a write.

finalIndependentAcceptance.sourceInvariant: A repeated consume for an ID in unrecorded retries the current complete backlog. Acceptance, consumption and Release clear pending-removal tracking only after their synchronous current-state commit succeeds. Already committed and truly unknown IDs return idempotent Done without a new write.
